limitations: Commission report (Qld Parliament tabled paper 5413T2967) returned HTTP 403; not read. Figures from press.

title: Feds slam both Oracle, state officials for problems with troubled health care exchange (Cover Oregon)
excerpt: CMS report faulted Oracle and lax state management; Cover Oregon "largely dependent on the vendor"; First Data audit cited lack of an independent systems integrator.
limitations: Press summary of contested government/partisan reports; Oracle disputes; source reports not read.

title: Delivering large-scale IT projects on time, on budget, and on value
excerpt: "On average, large IT projects run 45 percent over budget and 7 percent over time, while delivering 56 percent less value than predicted"; >5,400 projects; large = initial budget >$15m; 17% threaten company existence.
limitations: Consultancy publication; sample selection and value-measurement method not public; dated (2012).

title: Why Your IT Project May Be Riskier than You Think (Flyvbjerg & Budzier)
excerpt: 1,471 IT projects; average cost overrun 27% "but that figure masks a far more alarming 'fat tail' risk".
limitations: Abstract read via search; full article not read; 'one in six / 200%' tail statistic NOT verified and not used.

title: The rise and fall of the Chaos report figures (Eveleens & Verhoef)
excerpt: Standish definitions are "based solely on estimation accuracy"; one-sided accuracy measure leads to unrealistic success rates; tested on 5,457 forecasts of 1,211 projects.
limitations: Abstract only; used to justify NOT quoting Standish CHAOS percentages.

title: What IT leaders must do to avoid disappointing ERP initiatives
excerpt: By 2027, more than 70% of recently implemented ERP initiatives will fail to fully meet their original business case goals; as many as 25% will fail catastrophically.
limitations: Prediction, not measurement; full research paywalled; methodology not visible.

title: Align, focus and believe: Lessons from Commonwealth Bank's core banking transformation
excerpt: "originally planned for three dress rehearsals... We did five in the end"; target "eight hours or less"; "only fully offline for three hours"; 18-month migration; 16 million active accounts; 54 test crews.
limitations: Company self-report; no independent verification; no rollback or parallel-run detail.

title: Nordea core banking programme coverage (EUR344m impairment; Finnish savings accounts migrated to T24)
excerpt: EUR344m impairment on legacy systems at programme start; April 2018: "we migrated just under 250,000 existing savings accounts... the remaining accounts will be migrated in the coming weeks"; 2021 reports of slow progress.
limitations: Search excerpts only; programme cost/outcome not established; no 2018 scale-back confirmed.

title: Thought Machine partners with AWS on AI-powered solution to accelerate legacy banking migrations
excerpt: Extracts legacy business logic into EARS specifications; "compressing multi-year processes into days"; "Human-in-the-Loop review gates give bank engineering and risk teams explicit sign-off authority".
limitations: No customer results or numbers; vendor engineers required via accelerator programme.

title: Lloyds bank to migrate hundreds of thousands of customers to Google-inspired fintech
excerpt: Lloyds planned to move 500,000 customer accounts from legacy IT onto Thought Machine's platform; context of TSB failure.
limitations: Search excerpt; outcome not established. No independent evidence found for Mambu or 10x migration-cost claims.

title: Import payment data to Stripe (PAN import)
excerpt: "Processors can take anywhere from a few days to several months to produce a final export"; validation summary approved by merchant; mapping file old->new IDs; "You can export your data to any PCI-compliant processor"; new MID may raise declines, ramp volume.
limitations: Process documentation; timing claims (10 business days) are vendor claims.

title: §170.315(b)(10) Electronic Health Information export: test method
excerpt: "Enable a user to timely create an export file(s) with all of a single patient's electronic health information" "without subsequent developer assistance to operate"; population export; "publicly accessible hyperlink of the export's format".
limitations: Certification criterion; capability due to customers by 31 Dec 2023 per ONC factsheet (factsheet URL 404 on access).

title: FHIR Bulk Data Access IG STU2: Export
excerpt: Async pattern with 202 and Content-Location polling; "The server SHALL support Newline Delimited JSON"; system/patient/group export; _since: resources changed after supplied time; SMART Backend Services authorization.
limitations: STU3 (v3.0.0) is current; STU2 page read.

title: RFC 7644: System for Cross-domain Identity Management: Protocol
excerpt: "an application-level HTTP-based protocol for provisioning and managing identity data on the web and in cross-domain environments"; bulk operations; "SCIM's intent is to reduce the cost and complexity of user management operations".
limitations: Read first half only.

title: Mobilize your organization to accelerate large-scale migrations (AWS Prescriptive Guidance) and AWS MAP
excerpt: Large migrations in three phases: assess, mobilize, migrate; mobilize includes implementing a landing zone; migrate phase uses patterns and tools "defined and tested during the mobilize phase".
limitations: Search excerpts of overview pages; AWS Migration Hub closed to new customers Nov 2025 per AWS doc.

title: Best Practices with Any Data Loader; Loading Data from the API (LDV)
excerpt: "Create custom fields to store legacy ID information... External ID attribute so it will be indexed. This will help maintain relationships, and help you build custom reports for validation"; load users, then accounts, then opportunities.
limitations: Search excerpt; defer-sharing guidance comes from a 2013 developer blog.

title: Workday methodology / Launch customer deployment resources
excerpt: Stages Plan, Configure, Test, Deploy; "Faster time to value by quickly deploying an initial solution"; "Optimization of the existing solution through product updates and configuration, not customization"; foundation tenant as baseline configuration.
limitations: No duration or data-conversion specifics found.

title: Closed block insurance outsourcing / AI can accelerate life closed block migration
excerpt: Complexity and age of legacy closed-block systems present significant migration challenges; recommends starting with business rule extraction; outsourcing cedes data and reporting risk; policies remain in force 20-40 years.
limitations: Consultancy marketing with commercial interest; claimed 20-40% savings not verified.

title: New study finds Salesforce economy will create 9.3 million jobs and $1.6 trillion in new business revenues by 2026
excerpt: IDC projects ecosystem earns $6.19 for every $1 Salesforce makes by 2026 (2019 study: $5.80 by 2024).
limitations: Vendor-commissioned projection; includes non-implementation spend; indicator of services intensity only.

title: CBA selects SAP for core banking overhaul / Core banking modernisation media release
excerpt: April 2008: four-year A$580m Core Banking Modernisation with SAP and Accenture; later reporting put cost at ~A$1.1bn.
limitations: Search excerpt; later cost figure from iTnews not verified.
